test.create_query: CREATE TABLE string_size_read_planning_{serialization} ( id UInt64, s String ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY id % 64 ORDER BY id SETTINGS serialization_info_version = 'with_types', string_serialization_version = '{serialization}', ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0

query.tag: String size planning without early reads

test.query: SELECT s, s.size FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} FORMAT Null
SELECT id FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} PREWHERE s.size > 0 FORMAT Null

query.tag: String size planning with a full-String filter

test.query: SELECT id FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} PREWHERE s.size > 0 AND position(s, 'x') = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT s FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} FORMAT Null

query.tag: String size planning in the same PREWHERE step

test.query: SELECT s, s.size FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} PREWHERE s.size + position(s, 'x') > 0 FORMAT Null

query.tag: String size planning in the same main reader

test.query: SELECT s, s.size FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} PREWHERE id % 3 != 0 FORMAT Null

query.tag: String size planning with repeated size inputs
Repeated size inputs with an output-only String

test.query: SELECT s, s.size FROM string_size_read_planning_{serialization} PREWHERE s.size > 0 AND id % 3 != 0 AND s.size + id > 1 FORMAT Null

query.tag: Repeated size inputs after a shared String reader
Size input before a shared String reader
